name: zapis-kg
description: Zapis.kg: multi-tenant CRM and online booking for service businesses in Kyrgyzstan

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.format: npm run format -w backend && npm run format -w frontend
